title: Before The Bell: IBM's AI platform, Rocket Lab's NASA wins, Oracle's Tencent deal
description:
Data as of Oct 1, 2026 8:58 AM ET
IBM unveiled a self-hosted AI platform and bought Logiq Consulting, Rocket Lab won new NASA missions, and Oracle reportedly signed a $7B AI chip deal with Tencent. Your portfolio is up 28% all time, and Oracle goes ex-dividend around October 8, about $25 to you.
The Ask answer was recorded at 11:26 AM ET.
